app.name: Diff Viewer
app.description: Compare two texts or files side by side or inline, with syntax highlighting, whitespace-insensitive comparison, change navigation and patch export.

sides.placeholderOriginal: Paste or type the original text, or open a file.
sides.placeholderChanged: Paste or type the changed text, or open a file.
sides.notKeptHint: This side is too large to keep after the window closes; open the file again next time.

status.endings: Line endings differ ({{a}} / {{b}}); the comparison ignores them and a patch uses LF.

patch.tooDifferent: The texts are too different to make a patch in time.

actions.newBody: Both sides will be cleared. Files you opened are not changed.
